review.note: Date, 27 Stat. 993 and Harrison are right. Predecessor name restored from the OCR "Jhjite": White River Plateau Timber Land Reserve.

designationHistory.indexOriginal: Jhjite River Plateau Timber Land: Established reserve.

designationHistory.indexText: White River Plateau: Boundary redescribed. Name changed to White River.

sources.name: Establishment and Modification of National Forest Boundaries: A Chronologic Record, 1891–1985 (USDA Forest Service, Lands Staff, 1985), PDF page 11

review.note: Proclamation 479, June 28, 1902, 32 Stat. 2008, Theodore Roosevelt; redescribed the boundary and renamed the reserve White River.
